items.title: Losing loser won’t ever erase the stain of losing the midterms
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Imagine, if you will, that you are United States President Chucklefuck McDingleberry.

Your second term in office has been such a shittacular disaster that your own party has just taken a historic drubbing in the midterms. You’re radioactive right now. The voters have pantsed you. You’ve now been outed as a loser. The rats are leaving your sinking ship. Everyone loathes you. Even your most die-hard cultists are all, History will remember you as a failure. The worst of the worst.

Given all that, what do you do for an encore?

“When you look at that White House, you know, I hear Obama, but he— Obama doesn’t know about dirt and filth. And he doesn’t know about cracked stones. And he doesn’t know about broken windows. He’s probably fine with them. But I’m not. I’m not fine with them.”

Holy fuck, Obama’s tossed-off crack about how Donny’s Oval Bordello ‘looks like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory’ really really got under Donny’s supernaturally-thin skin. He’s still shitting himself raw over it, a week later.

Meet the new Donny, same as the old Donny.

Any competent leader, after being handed such a humiliating loss, would be meeting with staff, and going, ‘how do we fix this? How do we rebuild the trust of the people?’ But not Donny. He is fundamentally incapable of reflection, introspection, or change. He never has been, and he never will be. So he’s going to pretend it never happened. He’s going to blunder right ahead, doing the same old shit, telling the same old lies, boasting about the same old imaginary accomplishments, building the same old useless monuments to himself — and nursing the same old grievances and grudges.

Oh, and Donny has a cunning plan to force everyone to ‘enjoy’ his Oval Bordello in perpetuity.

Donald Trump signed a proclamation on Thursday that he says will prevent future administrations from changing his design of the Oval Office and Cabinet Room, spaces which he declared as national monuments that should be preserved.

See you in court, if you think that’s ever going to happen, fuckface. Every president gets to decorate their own Oval Office. It’s historical precedent.

I have a better idea. Instead of deeming Dear Leader’s vulgar monuments to himself to be worthy of preservation, how about creating a National Registry of Fucking Eyesores To Be Demolished? Because that’s what Donny’s really leaving behind. Fucking eyesores, to be demolished.

  • The Epstein Dance Hall where the East Wing used to be.

  • The Epstein Parking Lot where the Rose Garden used to be.

  • The Epstein Trough of Rancid Water where the Reflecting Pool used to be.

  • The Epstein Helipad where the South Lawn used to be.

And, of course, the Saddam Hussein Cheesecake Experience where the Oval Office used to be.

But it’s not just judge who blocked that shit. It’s a judge we already know and love.

U.S. District Judge Tanya S. Chutkan blocked work on the arch for two weeks while the court considers challenges to its legality. Three Vietnam War veterans, a historic preservationist, the D.C. government and the Commonwealth of Virginia sued to halt construction.

That’s right, it’s She’s the judge who was presiding over Donny’s Big January 6th Insurrection Fuckery Trial, until his reelection put the kibosh on that.

She has no patience for any of Dear Leader’s bullshit, once literally ruling ‘presidents are not kings,’ in a judgement against Donny. It’s heartening to see that she’s still out here, fighting all the good fights, and still getting in Donny’s way.

We thank you for your service.

But it doesn’t matter how man shitty monuments this pathetic dipshit erects in his own fragile, needy honor. He’s never going to erase the stain of being a losing loser who fucked his own party nearly out of existence.

I JUST WASN’T ON THE BALLOT. IF I WERE, WE WOULD HAVE WON IN A LANDSLIDE! President DONALD J. TRUMP

This is now the second time he’s posted this nonsense. Overcompensating much, dumb-ass?

Shut up, loser. You’re a losing loser who loses, and everyone knows it.

Which brings us to our of schadenfreude.

Outgoing Republican Senator Bill Cassidy is very perplexed right now. Apparently, it has just come to the Senator’s attention that an elected official has to — it says here,

“If you look at the shellacking our party took, it’s pretty clear that most voters don’t think that we were there to serve them. They thought, once more, that the politicians wanted to keep power so much that they were willing to change the rules to make the people serve the politicians.”

Wait, was that wrong, to ignore the needs of We the People, opting instead to allow Dear Leader to do whatever the fuck he wanted, and to actually aid and abet him?

I tell ya, Bill Cassidy has to plead ignorance on this thing. Because if anyone had said anything at all to him when he first became a senator that that sort of thing was frowned upon…

Cassidy was the deciding vote on Todd Blanche. He can eat a dick.

Hang on, we should fact-check this. Is that true? Can Senator Cassidy eat a dick?

Yes, he can. Because not only was Cassidy the deciding vote on letting the Donny’s personal ambulance-chaser become Attorney General — he was also the deciding vote on Bobby Brainworms being put in charge of our nation’s healthcare.

Sorry, but the Esteemed Senator doesn’t get to go on cable news and point his finger at everyone else. His hands are as dirty as the rest of his party’s.

Bill Cassidy can go pound salt.

Remember how bleak and hopeless things seemed, that morning?

bleak and hopeless, for a good long while. It

Here’s what I wrote in that post from November 6, 2024.

America is about to go through some things. This hurts a lot, I know. Remember, we still have each other. We’re all in this together.

Let the events of the past week be a reminder that situations can and do change for the better, when we all work together. We will always be here for each other. We will always be in this together.

Which brings me to . Someone’s come up with an all-new reason for canceling their paid subscription. It’s because I’m obsolete!

Okay, that made me laugh out loud. I can’t even get disgruntled by it. Seriously, if anyone feels they no longer need a daily dose of this shit,

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here’s Ms Spouse, so bemused by something she saw going on in the background in Half Moon on March 8, 2024, that she took out her phone and captured it.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: All we want are Democrats who’ll fight the fascists. Is that too much to ask?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
‘You’re not a wartime Consigliere.’

That’s Michael Corleone’s famous line from The Godfather, in which he explains to Corleone family counselor Tom Hagen that shit’s about to get real, and you don’t have what it takes.

Know who else isn’t a ? Hakeem Fucking Jeffries, the Man Who Would Be Speaker of the House. Jeffries couldn’t his way out of a paper bag. I’m not even sure he understands what the actual job entails.

Morning Joe: “Donald Trump said ‘I am your retribution,’ and he got wiped out. How do you now say, ‘hey, let’s not look behind us. We’re going to focus on bringing costs down’?”

Hakeem Jeffries: “The American people don’t want us to get even, they want us to get things done on their behalf.”

Holy shit, that sounds like a carefully-rehearsed line, doesn’t it? Why?

I’ve never understood this pathological compulsion of Democratic leadership to go out the morning after every election and immediately piss all over everyone’s corn flakes. Is it too much to ask, to let us savor a victory for one whole day, before you start shitting all over everything?

Why this need to assure us that there won’t be any ? No one’s asking for ‘retribution.’ What we want is . We’ve just lived through two years of the greatest lawlessness and corruption from a federal government that this country has ever experienced — big strong corruption with tears in its eyes — and now it’s time for some accountability. That’s not

Preznit Fuckwit spent two years treating the US Treasury as his personal cash machine, fattening his wallet at our expense. We the People are struggling to make ends meet, while Dear Leader is somehow now a billionaire. Calling him to account for that is not

Holding Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand accountable for clownfucking us into an unwinnable war that destroyed our military readiness and set the world’s economy teetering on the edge of a crash, that’s not

Holding everyone at Homeland Security accountable for masked ICE thugs disappearing innocent people into Salvadoran slave labor gulags, or leaving them shot to death on the street, that’s not

It’s getting fucking justice, and it’s high time we had a little around here.

How did Hakeem Jeffries allow himself to get manipulated by that useless pantload Morning Joe into disavowing ?

Could it be because he’s ?

You know who else isn’t a ? Chuck Fucking Schumer. He’s been proving it every day through his impotent lack of action. Schumer’s a great guy to have around if there’s absolutely nothing at stake.Need someone to speak at the dedication of a new post office? Chuck’s your man. Need someone to make sure all the procedural i’s are dotted and t’s are crossed in some piece of shrimp boat legislation? Here comes Chuck!

Do you need someone to fight fascism? Chuck’s your— wait, where the fuck did Chuck go? He was here a minute ago.

He’s probably busy writing a strongly-worded letter.

Fortunately, we do have Democrats who aren’t so tone deaf, and do know how to say — and do — the right things.

In case you somehow missed it in yesterday’s post, let me just leave this right here.

That’s Rep. Robert Garcia, the Democrat who is now the incoming chairman of the House Oversight Committee. He posted that Tuesday night, after winning his own reelection.

Know who Rep. Garcia replaces as Oversight Chair? This rake-stepping fuckwit, Comer Fudd.

Is that an upgrade, or what? Imagine going from clownish side-show hearings involving Hunter Biden’s freakishly-oversized trouser trout, to actual investigations into how companies that Donny’s felonious failsons are invested in ended up getting billions of dollars in government defense contracts. You want to talk about an actual crime family? Boy, have I ever got one for you.

Here’s what Rep. Stansbury has to say about her video.

ARE YOU ALL READY FOR THIS???! 💙🔥 Because we are JUST GETTING STARTED!

Do you know who else are ready to fight the current Republican regime?

Many Republican lawmakers and allies alarmed by Tuesday’s wipeout are moving swiftly to pin blame for the election results on Hegseth, arguing behind the scenes that he played a chief role in convincing Trump to attack Iran with no exit strategy — and no plan for managing the inevitable political fallout.

They’re not wrong about how we got bogged down in the Middle East. Piss-Drunk Pete absolutely snookered his demented boss, and filled his ears with fairy-tale nonsense about how he could bomb the shit out of Iran and be won and done in a couple of hours, with plenty of time left over for Pete to get soused down at the local bar.

‘Drinnnkssss are on me, I just whupped Iran’s assssssss.’

How did that work out for you, Pete? How did that work out for any of us?'

Sucks to be you right now, Pete. They’re shoving you into a peach.

House Republicans are expected to vote to directly repudiate the defense secretary in a matter of days. Rep. Thomas Massie of Kentucky, the famously anti-Trump GOP lawmaker, told CNN he plans to trigger a vote to impeach Hegseth when Congress returns next week — and multiple GOP sources said they expect it to pass.

Leave it to Republicans to show us how it’s done. They’re not even waiting until the next Congress to stick their knives into their targets. They’re doing it

Maybe Hakeem Jeffries might wan to take lessons from Thomas Massie.

And now we must interrupt this post for an important message from Daughter Katie.

I’m sure you love taking requests, so: you should use your platform to encourage people to call their new representatives and yell at them to demand they not put Jeffries and Schumer back in charge.

Folks, Ms Spouse and I raised our daughter right, didn’t we? In fact, Katie is absolutely correct. We should all be calling our Reps and Senators (or their replacements) right now, and demanding leadership that will work to please , and not Morning Joe.

All those phone numbers and shit can be found at the House and Senate web sites.

Key Senate progressive Chris Van Hollen said Wednesday that Democrats should demand a “bold agenda” targeting entrenched corporate interests in Washington before agreeing to back Chuck Schumer or any other aspiring Senate majority leader.

It’s our job to push — — them across the finish line.

“Somebody came in, in the break there, and brought me a quote that we got from the president from the White House tonight, in response to the results, and I just threw it away. HA HA HA HA HA! That felt good, too. Guess what? It doesn’t matter. What do you think? Who has to care?”

Ah, that glorious moment when you realize that Dear Leader

We’re all about ready for some Daily Claudia now, right?

Since Katie’s already made an appearance in this post, let’s continue the theme. Here she is with her mom in Newport, Rhode Island, early 1990s.

This one’s at home, in the early 1990s.

And, lastly, Katie in front of her house, with her mom, on June 20, 2018.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

items.title: Democrats, fuck yeah!
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Loyal and patriotic citizens, please stand by for a message of the utmost importance from the President of the United States, Supreme Ruler of the Western Hemisphere, Lord-Emperor of the Sky Above and All the Planets, Conqueror Of Every War, God’s Own Avatar on Earth, Grand Re-namer of Water, and the Dumbest Fucking Imbecile to Ever Shit Himself Raw In the Oval Bordello.

“I wasn’t on the Ballot and if I was, we would have won IN A LANDSLIDE! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP”

Oh, come off it, you tiresome crybaby.

How many times did this repulsive dipshit tell everyone to pretend that was on the ballot? According to the WaPo, it was at least 41 times over the past couple of weeks. Yeah, well, guess what, Nimrod — everyone vote as if you were on that ballot of theirs. Don’t go to us if you don’t like the results.

You shit your bed. Now go lie in it.

(Folks, I’m running on way too much caffeine and way too little sleep this morning. I’m going to jot down a couple of quick hits and then maybe toddle back to bed.)

Well, we did it. We ran the table, and flipped both the House and the Senate back to Democratic control.

Now we can begin to dismantle this whole wretched experiment in what would happen if we took a greedy moron, put him in charge of an entire country, and let him to whatever the fuck he wants.

Yesterday, almost all the heroes who were supposed to win, did. Among them were James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa in Texas. Annie Andrews in South Carolina. Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayad, who becomes the first Muslim in the Senate.

And almost all the shitbags who supposed to lose, lost. The rank, amateurs, like Darline Graham. The malodorous, what-the-fuck-is-he-even-doing-here political tourists, like Vivek Ramaswamy. The low-wattage corruption-factories like Ken Paxton, who couldn’t even articulate a reason for running, beyond

And, most deliciously, that useless lump of protoplasm up in Maine, the one who’d spent thirty years doing fuck-all, apart from collecting a paycheck. I wonder what Susan Collins will do next? I’m really concerned, aren’t you?

BANGOR, Maine — Sen. Susan Collins (R-Maine) greeted supporters at her election party throughout the night but was a no-show after losing her bid for a sixth term.

Her campaign played Semisonic’s “Closing Time” and began packing up the room without any concession speech from Collins.

Oh, and I regret that I must inform you that Jon Husted’s impossibly-sculpted ass — that big, strong gluteus, with tears in its eyes — lost its bid for reelection, too.

The whole country is mad at the GOP right now. Here’s just one measure of how pissed off: the last time Kansas elected a Democratic senator was 1932.

Republicans have no one to blame but themselves. They really take a greedy moron, put him in charge of an entire country, and let him do whatever the fuck he wanted to.

Then they stepped back and completely abdicated their Constitutionally-mandated role to act as a check against dumbfuckery. Whatever the moron wanted, that was fine with then.

Incoherent tariffs? Go for it, Dear Leader. Unconstitutional executive orders? You do you, bro. Fire all the experts and replace them with morons? Sounds good to us. Prosecute political enemies? Knock yourself out. Send masked thugs to disappear people off the streets, and shoot anyone they want? Sure, why not? Kick millions of people off their healthcare so that gazillionaires can have another tax cut? Have at it. Bulldoze half the White House to rubble and replace it with some farkakte dance hall? Fucking go nuts. Wage illegal wars and alienate all our allies? What could possibly go wrong?

And look what happened. The moron broke our entire fucking country. The whole thing! Do you know how hard it is to break a country the size of America? It’s like trying to bankrupt a casino. People thought was impossible, until Donny came along.

Do you know how badly you have to fuck up to get Republicans to vote for Democrats?

And now the grown-ups have to come in and fix all that shit. I better not hear one complaint about how much it’s costing or how much time it’s taking. Don’t make me come over there and explain just how much stuff is broken.

That’s Rep. Robert Garcia, the Democrat who is now the incoming chairman of the House Oversight Committee. He posted that last night, after winning his own reelection.

He’s talking to you, Donny. And you, Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand. You too, Bobby Brainworms. Don’t pretend you can’t hear him over the noise of that whale-head-separating chainsaw. He’s talking to all of you White House shitweasels.

Lawyer the fuck up. Accountability is coming.

Hey — I know what would be fun right about now. Let’s overdose on schadenfreude while watching MAGA completely lose their shit on Elon’s Nazi Bar.

I’m going to give the final word today to Mister Barack HUSSEIN Obama, because he’s so good at being gracious. Me, I at grace.

Tonight, the American people sent a clear message — they want a politics that brings people together rather than divides them, and leaders who offer concrete solutions to the challenges they face.

These results were only possible because outstanding candidates stepped forward in every region of the country — including in areas once considered long shots. They came from different backgrounds and represented a range of political perspectives, but were united by shared values, a belief in public service, and a commitment to putting the people of their districts and states first.

We also owe a debt of gratitude to the thousands of election officials and volunteers from both parties who helped ensure a smooth election and carried out one of the most essential functions of our democracy.

While this administration has another two years in office, our job now is to roll up our sleeves, make changes wherever we have the power to do so, prevent further damage, and lay the groundwork for the future.

He really is so truly good at this. As I keep saying, I think this kid’s going to have a real future in front of him, some day.

And isn’t in nice that, at least this one time, we all get a puppy — as opposed to, y’know, ?

Not just a puppy, but a Daily Claudia, too.

Let’s do some random selfies. Here’s Half Moon in Dobbs Ferry on April 15, 2025.

In the car on January 17, 2025.

And a very special shout-out to my friend Sam, who texted the following to me at 11:30 last night.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone.

items.title: Election 2026 — let’s fucking do this
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Hey, everyone — today’s election day.I feel good about our chances.

Now, of course, I say that while still bearing residual PTSD from telling everyone in 2024 about how good I felt about our chances then. But, nonetheless, today I feel good.

Our candidates are young, smart, energetic, charismatic and inspiring. Our side is caring, with a sense of fairness and justice for everyone.

Their side sucks all ass.

Now, I hear you asking, ‘Uncle Jeff, why are you showing us a photo of just the Pool? I thought you said there was a rally going on.’

Silly rabbit, look closer. That the rally. Keep looking, I promise you there’s a rally in there. Come on, zoom way in. :

Oh my dear sweet lord,

Yup, that’s the rally. The one that was supposed to sum up the entire campaign.

Who thought this would be a good idea? Who let Donny do this? Who allowed Dear Leader to go out and humiliate himself like this in public?

The answer is ‘no one.’ This all is Donny’s own doing. He picked the location. He chose the subject matter. He’s the one who decided a whole rally should be themed around the Reflecting Pool that wasn’t broken, but nonetheless got the fixed out of it. He’s the one who then didn’t bother to publicize it, or invite voters to attend.

Donny’s too demented to understand that stunts like this are completely sabotaging his own party’s chances in the midterms. He thinks he’s fucking crushing it. And no one can stop him.

“We were losing on average, TO DEATH, 3— people— a week. And now we don’t have that. We don’t have that.”

Excuse me, what even is that gibberish? ‘We were losing on an average to death’? What kind of grammar is that?

We were, now? Were there indeed three people getting in a pool that’s 18 to 30 inches deep? That’s quite a statistic. What’s our takeaway, that only Dear Leader can prevent the heartbreak of getting drownalyzed in a thimble full of water?

How fucking demented to you have to be to fancy yourself the Un-Drowner of Lost Souls?

Republicans should be thanking their lucky stars that the campaign ended yesterday, because we were only two or three more days away from Donny emptying his diaper onto his head and demanding everyone sing along with him to a rousing chorus of

Oh, and Republicans? Get ready to bear the brunt of the blame when you lose today. Don’t expect any introspection from Dear Leader. He’s already denying having anything do with loss.

“For some reason, the sitting president doesn’t win the midterms. But we gave this a very strong shot.”

Got that? If you lose today, Dear Leader had nothing to do with it. It’s a just a thing that happens a sitting president. Poor Donny, bad things always happens him.

For sure, reasons abound during every election, as to why one side loses. But in this case, there’s one reason, and one specific reason alone: because everything is fucked to hell, and Dear Leader fucked it.

And that’s why that Reflecting Pool really the perfect metaphor for Donny’s entire second term — just not in the way that Donny imagines it is.

The entire world is now as fucked to hell as that Pool. Our economy. our healthcare, our immigration, our relationships with both our allies and adversaries, our energy policy, our military readiness, our supply chains, our trade. None of that was broken, but that didn’t stop Preznit Fuckwit from fixing the shit out of it.

So here were are, on the morning of the most important election of our lifetimes — just like the last one before it, and the last one before that. It’s exhausting, but that’s how shitty timelines roll. We don’t have the luxury of sitting any of this out.

Let’s do this. I like our chances. Let’s put some good people into power, and they can actually fix this shit, the way it’s supposed to be fixed. Let’s have accountability and justice in this country. Let’s stop allowing a greedy criminal to get away with doing whatever the fuck he wants. The same goes for his felonious family and corrupt cronies.

We’ve got this, as long as we show up to vote. That’s the easy part. It’s what comes next that’s going to try our souls.

Absolutely, there is going to be attempted fuckery. That’s what Donny does when he can’t get his way. He cheats like a whiny little piss-baby.

It’s going to get ugly — but so far, judges, lawyers, courts and even Supreme Court Justices have been keeping the 2026 midterms from descending into lawless chaos. I have every reason so expect these bulwarks against anarchy to continue to do so.

And on that note, I’m going to give the final word to Joyce Vance today. She’s already said it so well in her post from last night, so there’s no need for me to I reinvent the wheel.

If you’re nervous, you’re not alone. Be kind today. Hold a friend’s hand. Donate to a food bank. Get ready to vote and be prepared for the unexpected over the next few days. Remember that giants walk among us: lawyers, activists, pro-democracy politicians, federal judges who believe in the rule of law no matter who appointed them, and ordinary Americans who will be staffing and monitoring the polls to ensure we can all vote and our votes are counted. So be brave. Have courage. Vote.

As Joyce says at the end of every one of her posts, we are are in this together.

How would some Daily Claudia be right about now?

In honor of the day, let’s have Ms Spouse voting absentee on November 2, 2024, from the physical rehab center where she’d been recovering after falling and breaking her hip a few weeks prior.

Let’s move on to five months later, Ms Spouse having completely recovered. Here she is, waiting for our rental car at the San Diego Airport Sheridan, on March 16, 2025. That’s right, she made me travel all the way across the country

Now let’s turn the camera around, and let Ms Spouse take a photo of me.

Have a great Election Day, everyone.

items.title: The New York Times finally figures it out: Dear Leader is bugfuck nuts
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Holly shit, Look who just woke up from their decade-long slumber, to work out on their very own what the rest of us sussed out years ago.

Are you ready for this? You’d better sit down, because this is a real shocker. It turns out — according to none other than The New York Times — that Preznit Fuckwit might be a little bit cuckoo for cocoa-puffs.

Remember when the Times didn’t used to tell us shit we already knew, long after we already knew it?

Is there anything else you’d like to tell us, Captains Obvious? Water is wet, maybe?

Now, I see your hands up, and I know what you’re dying to ask: ‘Hey, Uncle Jeff — why has the Times waited until all the way to the very end of the election cycle to drop this news on us? Couldn’t we have used it months — or years — ago?’

He is cruder than he used to be, using nearly 15 swear words per 10,000 words compared with 14 two years ago and six a decade ago, a change consistent with age-related disinhibition.

The review, relying on an A.I.-assisted metric, found that he makes rambling or confusing digressions in his rallies and speeches two and a half times as often in his second term as in the 2016 campaign, although roughly the same as in 2024.

Got that? The Times couldn’t blow the whistle on Dear Leader until they had rock-solid proof, gathered over a period of time — and they couldn’t do it without a janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot to do them a solid, and help do all those fancy-ass calculations.

Yeah, I know — these are the same shit-kazoos who declared Joe Biden mentally incompetent after one time that he forgot someone’s name.

Joe gets unceremoniously tossed on the shit-pile of sayonara, while Donny is obviously a Very Special Boy Who Deserves Every Reasonable Doubt Before Judgement Is Cast.™

“He gave up all of— yeah, it was free. WE DON’T CARE if it was free. We don’t care. It’s free. They say, WE WANT TO KNOWWW why did he give a ball room? No, no, you don’t understand me. It’s a gift. To the [slurred] Unided Stades offa Meriga. WE DON’T CARE. We don’t care. [unintelligible]

What in the hell was that?

Preznit Fuckwit was supposed to be making his final argument for why voters should select Republicans. The final argument he actually made instead was why he should be carted off by the men with the butterfly nets.

Donny gets a dance hall, and We the People get fuck-all — while gas in America reaches an all-time second-term high, one day before the midterms.

By the way, who is paying $3.46 for a gallon of regular? Here in the Hudson Valley it’s more like $4.19.

Fox News bobblehead: “What’s your final message to voters to get them out?”“Poverty numbers are the single best. Meaning, they’re the best. Poverty’s a bad thing, but poverty is poverty.”

Oh, thank you for that explanation of — the best poverty ever. Big strong poverty, with tears in its eyes, going, ‘sir! Thank you, sir! How do you did it? How do you make us the best poverty ever? Sir!’

Don’t you love Donny hand-waving poverty away, the poverty he created? ‘Poverty is poverty, whatcha gonna do?’ Thanks for explaining that.

What kind of tone-deaf dumbfuckery is that, tumbling out of the rancid anus-mouth of some flim-flam man who’s grown rich off of grifting the rubes who worship him?

Yes, I know what Dear Leader is to say, about poverty, but he’s not saying it — because he’s fucked in the head — and presidents aren’t supposed to be fucked in the head.

But fucked in the head he is, and it shouldn’t have taken the New York Times ten years to figure out that he’s fucked in the head.

And still, the Times sugar-coats it.

Mr. Trump, who last year became the oldest person ever inaugurated as president and turned 80 in June, has demonstrated physical stamina as he barnstorms the country in advance of midterm elections.

And that, by the way, was Joe Biden’s real crime. He looked and sounded old — while Donny has gotten an endless serious of free passes, because he can still shit out nonsense while speaking in a mostly-loud voice.

I’ll bet the Times wants a cookie, as a reward for finally committing an

Sorry, no. You don’t get a cookie. You spent ten years sanewashing the incoherent ravings of a maniac.

Our press is supposed to warn us while shit is actually happening, and not wander in at the very end and go ‘hey, that was kind of fucked up, wasn’t it?’

Everything totally fucking sucks right now, but at least we can point and laugh at Comer Fudd’s newly-dyed hair.

Seriously, what the fuck? When last we saw James Comer, the rake-steppingest fuckwit in Congress, he was a dignified natural gray.

Of course, Comer Fudd’s hair was the only thingabout him, as he ginned up hearing after hearing in which he clownfucked himself into one embarrassing situation after another, all the while trying to prove that he was finally going to catch that wascally wabbit, Bugs Biden.

Comer Fudd never was able to pin one crime on Bugs Biden, but at least he didn’t look like some mid-life-crisis used-care-salesman while attempting to do so.

Oh well, let’s be philosophical about it. Who really cares what the hair color is, when it’s the face that’s getting smacked by an endless series of rakes?

Ah, there’s the Comer Fudd we all know and love.

And now let’s do us some Daily Claudia.

Here’s Ms Spouse getting in a little gardening on May 16, 2016.

Have a great Monday, everyone.

items.title: It’s Sunday. Let’s celebrate some heroes.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Yes, I know. Everything right now. But that doesn’t mean we can’t occasionally pause to celebrate the heroes within our midst.

Today, let’s do just that.

Sir Patrick Stewart passed away this week at the age of 86.

During his life, he’d been a Shakespearean actor, a starship captain, and a role model, beloved by millions.

But here’s another fun fact about Sir Pat: he fuckingDonny Convict. Check out this except from an interview Stewart did with the AV Club back in 2017.

“You might say to me, ‘well, you’re not an American. What has it got to do with you?’ The fact is, when America sneezes, the world catches a cold. And America, I think, is on the edge of a very bad flu infection. And it’s because of the man who is in the White House. I do find, as time goes by, I find myself becoming increasingly anxious.”

“I’m not a citizen,” he said. “However, there is, maybe it’s the only good thing, as the result of this election: I am now applying for citizenship. Because I want to be an American too.”

He added, “All of my friends in Washington said, ‘There is one thing you can do. Fight, fight, oppose, oppose.’”

Congratulations, Donny — you’re now an inspiration. Stand proud. No one every became a citizen just so they could vote against Joe Biden. You built that!

(Full disclosure: in the interest of Responsible Journalism and Everything™, I asked Google’s janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot if Patrick Stewart ever did become a US citizen. Sadly, the answer was ‘no,’ for a number of reasons. I don’t care. Sir Patrick is still a hero.)

Here’s another hero — actor Wil Wheaton, who played Ensign Crusher on Star Trek: The Next Generation.

Stephen Miller, on behalf of Star Trek, and everyone who knew and loved him, keep my Captain’s name out of your fucking Nazi mouth. He despised you, and everything you stand for.

Hang on, we should probably to do a quick fact check. Does Nosferatu McGoebbels. in fact have a ‘fucking Nazi mouth’?

Yes — yes he does. And I would add to the mix.

Look, I’m with Wil. Nosferatu needs to shut the fuck up. Whatever lessons he imagines he learned from watching Star Trek as a kid, he clearly got it wrong. There are no episodes where the fascist fuckwads are the guys. How does one watch Star Trek and come away with the conclusion that the racist oppressors are the icons?

Not all heroes wear capes. Sometimes they stand in the audience and yell shit.

I believe it was Jesus who so wisely counseled us in his Sermon on the Mount, ‘blessed are the hecklers, because they make the shit-gizzards we hate look like stupid dicks.’

It’s not just Dear Leader bearing the brunt of it. Republicans coast to coast are getting an earful from their fed-up constituents.

Ken Paxton: “Talk your friends. Talk to your family. Tell them the difference between me and James Talarico.”

Audience member: “Paxton, you take bribes!”

My god, is Ken Paxton the least-magnetic candidate, like, ever? He just stands there, farting tepid mouth-sounds out of his face-hole. He makes Couchfuck McGee seem like the most dynamic public speaker in the multiverse.

Who is supposed to walk away from this sleepwalked drivel, inspired to vote?

Can’t Paxton find himself a job where he can steal all the money he wants without having to bore people to death at the same time? Is that really too much to ask?

I have no idea who this couple is, or where they were. I learned about it from opening my social feeds last night, and there was this clip, all over the place.

All I know is that we need to gif that shit, pronto.

Holy shit, that’s some nightmare fuel right here. Fucking terrifying.

Folks, I’ve got one more hero for you. My very good friend Eliza Gilkyson has a new album coming out early next year.

This week, she posted a song from the album, to both Facebook and YouTube. Please give it a listen. I promise you,

‘In America’ is the first single from my upcoming album, LIFELINE, to be released in Feb., and due to its political nature, Facebook is not allowing me to boost the song during election week. So they have totally held me back, and that’s where you come in. We are allowed to post it, just not boost it. So if you can post the song on any of your socials and let your friends know they can do the same, then we can defy the muzzle order and let this song find its way to other like-minded souls during this worrisome week ahead of us.

Wouldn’t it be nice if we lived in a world where our tech-bro overlords didn’t tip the scales in favor of the fascists? What kind of un-American bullshit is ‘you can’t boost a political song before an election’? That’s unthinkable. What the fuck has happened to our country?

What episode of Star Trek was Zuck watching when he came away with the notion that being a greedy, oligarchic piece of shit was the true way forward? Because I don’t remember that one.

Oh, look. We’re down at the bottom of the post. You know what that means. It’s Daily Claudia time.

Today, let’s revisit cocktail hour on the patio of the Coast Guard House in Narragansett, Rhode Island, on September 21, 2023.

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This Week In Stupid: October 31 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

Monday: make America think again

Davram Steifler of the Good Liars: “What do you like so much about Donald Trump?”

Cultist: “Everything. He does what he says.”

Steifler: “The war in Ukraine, he said he was gonna end it on day one.”

Cultist: “I don’t know that much about it. I didn’t hear him say it.”

Steifler: “What policies do you think are gonna help Americans in the next couple years?”

Cultist: “Not gonna talk about that cause I don’t really know that much.”

Seriously, though — is this woman living a stress-free life, or what?

While the rest of us are out here, punching ourselves in the face and hassling over just trying to survive in a world where we’re governed over by fascist fuckwads, this woman hasn’t a care in the world.

She doesn’t know shit, and she doesn’t want to know shit. All she knows is what Dear Leader has told her is the True Way Forward.

I swear, I’m almost kinda jealous.

Tuesday: make America literate again

I mean, if you’re a cultist, you don’t even have to sweat over stuff like .

Folks, I swear to fuck, this ad is real. It was produced and paid for by the “Congressional Leadership Fund,” in support of some MAGAfied shit-kazoo named Brian Fitzpatrick, who is apparently running for reelection in some magical land of enchantment called

I shit you not. Take a closer look.

Again, it must be nice to be this serenely stupid. While the rest of us are out here, hassling over making sure every gets dotted and every gets crossed, Republicans aren’t even bothering to do the barest minimum. They just outsource everything to the nearest janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot, and no one even bothers to proofread the drek it shits out.

No wonder our country is circling the drain right now. We’re being governed over, not just by fascist fuckwads, but by fascist fuckwads who are morons.

Wednesday: make America completely lose its shit again

Here’s a fun thing that no doubt has George Orwell churning in his urn. If you go to the Wikipedia page for Mike Waltz, the US Ambassador to the United Nations, it describes him as a ‘diplomat.’

“And I’m the representative of the United States of America. BACK UP! Back up, Ambassador! Back away, this isn’t Havana. Do you understand who you’re dealing with? Back up!”

Gentlemen, you can’t fight in here. This is the General Assembly.

Dear Leader, of course, is too chickenshit to actually anyone who’s not a woman, so Drunk Dial Mike got shuffled over to the United Nations, because ? Skills — and anger management — are just as useful in the Donnverse as spelling is.

Thursday: make America Germany again

“To lie, so casually, so repeatedly, so comfortably. It’s genuinely so sociopathic. And they lied again and again and again, when everyone knows the truth.”

Wait — Stephen Miller is bragging about himself, isn’t he?

I’m so fucking exhausted by this asshole’s tiresome act. The lies. The projection. The over-the-top hysteria. The high-pitched caterwauling, delivered in a frequency that bats use to echolocate.

Astonishing. The hands, the expressions, the tone, the projection… He should get a Daytime Emmy for his impersonation—if you can get those in prison.

Seriously, we need to gif that shit for posterity’s sake.

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

On Friday, some fucking idiot had just one public appearance on his schedule — another pathetically tiny hate-rally in some shoebox of a high school gymnasium in who the fuck even cares where, these things are eternally interchangeable. The Fucking idiot just repeats the same shit over and over.

Seriously, the fucking idiot once again ticked all the boxes. He did a racism.

Trump on El-Sayed: I hope you send him back to where he came from.

Abdul El-Sayed was born in Michigan, so sure — let’s send him back to exactly where he is right now. It makes perfect sense to me.

Trump: Nobody knows DUMB has a B. I can’t believe it took me 9 years to figure it out.

Yes, I believe this is true. I believe it took the fucking idiot nine years to learn to spell a word. That’s how fucking idiots roll.

TRUMP: I looked at his ass and it was all muscle. I looked up and down his legs—very powerful.

TRUMP: I did not marry my sister. I had two lovely -- I have one left. Elizabeth. She’s great. But I have not -- I never proposed to them. They’re beautiful, but I was never — I was never particularly attracted to either of them. It’s not my deal.

Why do we need to know this? What’s the context? Why is the fucking idiot so compelled to assure us that he never fucked his sister? Is this one of those every-accusation-is-a-confession things? Wait, I don’t want to know.

Oh, and the fucking idiot got heckled — because that’s a thing that now happens at every single one of the fucking idiot’s hate-rallies.

After the hate-rally was over, the fucking idiot’s hair was so embarrassed by what had gone on that it tried to escape.

But because the fucking idiot never takes questions from the press while doing hate-rallies, not one reporter had the opportunity to stand up and ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia.

Yesterday evening, as I was sitting by myself, having dinner at the bar of the Hudson Valley Steakhouse, a reader of these posts recognized me, and came up to offer her condolences. Thank you, .

In honor of that, here’s another triptych from the Hudson Valley Steakhouse, on November 29, 2024.

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone. I will never get used to being recognized in public.

items.title: President Rottinghands McCankles cancels his remaining rallies. What a fucking loser.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Yesterday evening, out of the clear blue and without warning, the White House abruptly announced that all of Dear Leader’s upcoming weekend rallies had been canceled — fuckity-bye, hit the bricks, sayonara — thereby depriving his remaining cultists the opportunity to sit uncomfortably on a folding chair in a thimble-sized gymnasium, and listen to Donny ramble incoherently for two entire hours about how he successfully pointed at the drawing of the camel, all while being drowned out by an endless series of hecklers.

Reporter Jacob Bogage: “So you not going to Kansas has nothing to do with you being sick of traveling?”

Donny: “Oh, you’re sick to ask that question. You are sick. Who are you with?”

Bogage:

Donny: “You are a sick guy. Reuters is terrible. Can you imagine? Look at this guy. He’s way out of shape. Look at how bent— he comes [makes accordion hands] he comes to me. ‘Sir, you’re not gonna go to Kansas.’ I’m not going to Kansan because he’s doing very well. We’re gonna do a tele-rally’ … but he says, ‘you’re not going to Kansas, sir, are you feeling well?’ You’ve been following me for two weeks. I feel perfect. You are disgusting. Put yourself in shape. You look like hell.”

Wow, Dear Leader sure gets cranky when he’s got a full load in his diaper — and he didn’t even hear the question correctly. Did you catch that? The reporter asks Donny if he’s and Donny goes ballistic because all he hears is And he automatically explodes into some infantile rant about ‘I’m not sick, you’re sick’ — because he’s got the emotional maturity of a four-year-old.

Maybe Donny needs to get his ears checked.

Is this a piece of your brain, Donny?

Dear Leader can’t hack it any more. He’s too old and tired and demented to be flying across the country every single goddamned day. Plus, he’s fed up. He loves the crowds — only this time around, there aren’t any crowds. All that remains are the die-hard, brain-deadest cultists — and there aren’t even enough of them left to fill the pint-sized high school gyms his flunkies are booking him into. How long before Donny has to open for a

‘Oh Natty, you’re the only one who understands me.’

I think I just threw up in my own mouth a little.

So now, if you’re a cultist and you need your Donny fix this weekend, you’re going to have to zoom in to some ‘tele-rally,’ and watch Dear Leader sitting behind the Resolute Desk, drooling all over himself as he gradually loses consciousness. It’ll be just like a real rally, except you won’t be able to smell the farts.

Meanwhile, let’s go live to Republican National Headquarters for the GOP’s reaction to Donny having canceled his remaining rallies.

“Sources say, though, that some Republican officials are relieved by the president’s decision to cancel those final two rallies. One top Republican official told my colleague Jeff Zeleny, quote, ‘thank God. He hasn’t moved the needle anywhere.’ And a second official, saying, quote, ‘everyone has seen the president who wants to see him.’”

Boo fucking hoo, Republicans. Maybe it was a mistake to hitch your wagons to an increasingly-befuddled fascist who, thanks to an increasing fog of dementia and untreated tertiary syphilis, no longer has any idea which end is up.

Reporter: “Have you heard that Lt. General Sylvia leaked classified information at the Pentagon?”

Reporter: “I said, Lt. General Sylvia leaked classified information at the Pentagon.”

Donny: “ got problems. gonna have big problems. did. We’re very much looking for leakers, and uh—gonna have big problems.”

Surely, Donny can’t be this seriously misinformed, can he?

Spoiler alert: yes he can be this misinformed. Remember, Donny’s daily intel briefing has been boiled to down to a single page of bullet points and burlesque photos from the 1940s.

That’s the only thing that will hold Donny’s attention. So he hasn’t a fucking clue who Lt. General Sylvia is. All he hears is the name ‘Sylvia’ and away he goes, blithering about the retribution he’s going to inflict on some imaginary woman who doesn’t exist.

I’m so old, I remember when Job Biden would occasionally stumble over someone’s name, and would have to correct himself. The press would have a field day, and start filling editorial pages with piece after piece about how Sleepy Joe was too old and icky and smelly do to his job, and how he needs to step down, right now, for the good of the country.

Now we have an actual cognitively-collapsed president concocting fairy tales about strange generals, lying in ponds, distributing leaks — and not one worthless scribbler of the corporate-controlled press can be bothered to say one word about it.

It’s so embarrassing to have a President of the United States who is an uninformed fool who has no fucking clue what’s going on inside his own government, and just makes shit up on the spot, based on what’s he’s

But tell me once again how it was Joe Biden who was the real problem. That’s such an awesome story.

I swear, I yam disgustipated.

Fox News bobblehead: “Tom, why are you here this morning?”

Tom: “Well, in the late 70s, I was a little too young to get involved and go to South America for the Jonestown Massacre. But this is as close as I’ll ever get, so that’s why I’m here.”

Bobblehead: “Wait, the Jonestown Massacre?”

Tom: “That’s right. There’s nothing like seeing a cult right up front, man.”

Bobblehead: “Maybe this is not a Trump supporter [walks away dejectedly]

And right there, that’s your problem for Fox news — and for all the wingnut media right now. When there are too few cultists in the crowd, it’s way too easy for any mischief-maker to walk up to the dude holding the microphone, and go

Masterful job, bro. Norway will be in touch to let you know when you can pick up your Nobel Trolling Prize.

[Oh, and that scream you just heard, that was me — because this is where I was in writing this post when I got the notification on my phone about Donny going ahead with the canceled rallies. I was this fucking close, man.]

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here are three photos off the same roll of film from the early 1990s. First, we have Ms Spouse setting up a slide for Katie, in our back yard.

Second, Ms Spouse in a hotel room in Plymouth, MA.

And lastly, Katie and her mom, on the beach in Plymouth.

Have a great Friday, everyone. May you have better timing than me, when news is breaking.

items.title: Barack Obama is basically now just farting in Preznit Fuckwit’s general direction
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
We’re going get to Barack HUSSEIN Obama taunting Donny a, I promise.

But first, we need to put our Hero of the Day right up top. At a hate-rally in Mississippi two days ago, this loyal, patriotic American had a heartfelt message of undying affection and support for Dear Leader. Let’s give it a listen.

“Release the Epstein Files! Shove that ballroom up your fat ass!”

How sad is it for Donny that he’s now been reduced to campaigning in such tiny little rinky-dink venues — high school gymnasiums and the like — that it only takes one determined heckler with a good set of lungs to throw the whole event off the rails?

Wait, did I say sad? I meant to say . Shoot that shit straight into my veins.

Honestly, I think Donny’s already got his beloved Epstein Dance Hall shoved up his fat ass. That’s the only reasonable explanation whatever the hell is going on back there these days.

And now, on to the main event. Remember the other day, when Obama thoroughly humiliated Donny by pointing that that the Oval Bordello has been tatted up with so much golden crap that it now ‘looks like Saddam Hussein opened up a Cheesecake Factory’?

Trump is BIG MAD about Obama saying the White House now looks like Saddam opened a Cheesecake Factory: “He’s not a smart guy. He's not smart at all ... for you to say it’s a Cheesecake Factory, that just shows why you were a lousy president.”

Shut the fuck up, Donny. Grow a sense of humor.

So of course, when faced with such an irresistible, thin-skinned piss-baby target, Obama did the only logical thing.

“What I said about them being directly responsible for rising prices, they did not argue with that. They did not deny that tariffs were contributing to higher costs per family. They didn’t say anything about that. I accused this administration, based on the facts, that they were engaging in unprecedented levels of corruption, they didn’t say anything about that. The president wasn’t even mad about the Saddam Hussein comparison. That part didn’t bother him. But he was very upset about the Cheesecake Factory comments. He took great umbrage. He said I didn’t understand the work of the artisans in the White House.

And they mobilized — it’s all crazy, but this is the crazy part — they mobilized a whole government response to that joke. Not to inflation, but to that joke. The White House even called the Secretary of the Treasury. This is the man who is in charge of the economy. The person who’s supposed to be figuring out how to make your life more affordable. The guy who’s supposed to be figuring out how to lower inflation. And reduce interest rates. They told him he should hold a press conference in front of the Cheesecake Factory.”

Come on, we’re supposed to believe that the guy who probably throws a thermonuclear shit-fit when the sommelier bring out the wrong vintage of Lafitte Rothschild — ‘I said the ’75, you peasant, not the ’76, what is wrong with you’ — is chowing down at any place with ‘factory’ in its name?

Bessent is the kind of shitweasel who goes ballistic if the valet leaves a fingerprint on the door of his Bentley. He’s not jamming any ‘French-dip cheeseburgers’ down his gullet.

As Obama so correctly points out, Scott Bessent has actual, important job that he should be busy with — but instead of doing any of that shit, Donny makes him drop everything to go stand in front of the nearest camera.

These are not serious people. They’re all fucking embarrassments.

None of Donny’s flunkies have any fucking idea how to their jobs. They have no clue how to fix any of the shit they’ve broken. All they want is to be famous and on TV. Instead of winning the unwinnable war he started, Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand holds useless photo-ops where he does the shittiest pull-ups you’ll even see. Why? How is that even relevant to anything related to his actual job?‘Gaze in awe at my weak-ass pullups.’ Yay, Pete.

The Secretary of Transportation has a reality show that no one watches. The Secretary of Health has a cooking show. Even Dear Leader has his own TV channel.

Remember that, the youtube channel that Dear Leader started when the networks held their impotent, one-day boycott of the White House press office? Of course you don’t remember. No one fucking remembers. But it’s still here, watched by absolutely nobody.

The only member of the Donnyverse who isn’t super horny to get himself on TV is Marco Rubio. He hides out in who the fuck even knows where he is, because he’s terrified that some reporter might ask him why he’s wearing oversized clown shoes.

Check out this shoebox. Can you guess what it is?

This is the Ohio venue where Donny held last night’s hate-rally. My god, it’s another tiny little gymnasium. How fucking pathetic. You can really feel the , can’t you? It’s five days before what’s probably the most consequential election of our lifetime, and the President of the United States can’t fill a room that holds three hundred people.

Now, remember what I said up top about how in a venue that small, any determined heckler with a powerful set of lungs could derail the whole thing, and make it come crashing to the ground?

“Trump went on the Jeffrey Epstein plane! Trump went on the Jeffrey Epstein plane! Butterscotch Hitler! Pumpkin Spice Pedo! Butterscotch Hitler! Pumpkin Spice Pedo! Ah ha ha ha!”

‘Pumpkin Spice Pedo,’ how fucking perfect is that? No notes.

I also love the way this guy manages to keep filming — and keep heckling — even as he’s wrestled to the ground by MAGA chuds and escorted all the way to the sidewalk by security.

This one’s for you, ma’am.

items.title: Happy 4th birthday to us all!
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Four years ago today, I created this newsletter with the half-baked notion that I might try my hand at writing something longer than a tweet.

I had no expectations of . If I had, I might have spent more than ninety seconds coming up with the name for this site.

I figured I might write a couple of things a week for a little while, grow tired of it, and then move on to the next shiny object.

that’s not how shit went down at all Here we are, four years later — and wow, .

That is flattering and humbling and … I really didn’t see it coming.

FOLKS, YOU ALL FUCKING RULE.

I want to thank everyone who signed up to receive the emails — and I especially want to thank all the people who have become commenters here.

Really. I reading your comments. I love it when you folks banter with each other. So many of you are clearly wittier and more knowledgeable than I — and I that.

It’s nice to be part of something positive — and not, like so much of the internet, toxic and hateful — and I have all of you folks to thank for that. have made this place what it is.

Without you, I’d just be shouting into the wind — and that shit gets old .

Let me once again take a moment to say thank you to the thousands of people who have posted, commented, private messaged, texted, and phoned to offer condolences. I love you all. I am blessed to be surrounded by an amazing, caring community. I love you all.

Thank you for hanging in there with me.

And, on that note, let us now have our Daily Claudia.

Today, Ms Spouse is going to blow out the birthday candles — first at the Hudson Valley Steakhouse in Yorktown Heights, NY, on February 11, 2022.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone. I’ll be back tomorrow, as always, to document the atrocities.

Happy fourth fucking birthday to all of us.
